sc: Forinthry Royal Knight Spear is a two-handed melee weapon cosmetic override unlocked by completing tier 14 of Forinthry Frontier with the premier pass.
Frozen Daemonheim Chestplate is a torso slot cosmetic override that can be obtained from the Artisan's Anvil promotion on Treasure Hunter or by buying it from the Smuggled Goods store.
It can be made at level 75 Crafting by sewing 5,000 ganodermic flakes onto a mycelium poncho web, granting 1,000 Crafting experience.
If they fully degrade, they will need to be re-created from the poncho web.
A hydrix necklace is a necklace made by crafting a gold bar and a hydrix at level 90 Crafting at any furnace, giving 135 experience.
It, along with the regular agility skillcape, could be unlocked by accounts in the Fresh Start Worlds game mode that reached level 99 Agility.

The cape can also still be unlocked by any account in the main game by consuming an Inverted Agility skillcape token, though the inverted cape can only be equipped if the player also has level 99 Agility.
The Iorwerth battleaxe is a cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing task 14 of the Yak to the Light event with the premium pass.
To obtain the pet the player must pop the Inflatable Invaders with the pointy stick obtained from Regina in front of Draynor Manor and get 100 balloon scraps.
The pet can now be bought from Diango's Toy Store for 5,000 coins.

Large glitter bomb.x: A large glitter bomb is a Treasure Hunter reward. The chosen skill receives 130% of the bonus experience that a large prismatic fallen star would yield, and the other skills 5% of the star's bonus experience.

sc: The lovestruck pendant is an item obtained by trading in 750 Valentine hearts from 14 February to 14 March 2013, or 150 rose petals from 12 February to 13 March 2015.
Like its Heartbreak pendant counterpart, only one pendant could be obtained prior to the 2017 event, and only the pendant obtained using Valentine hearts provides up to 34,400 bonus experience.

Malicious rogue gloves are a pair of gloves that can be bought for 300 Deathmatch points from the Deathmatch Reward Shop after the previous pairs have been bought, setting the total points required at 900 points.
Prior to the release of Deathmatch, rogue gloves could be found in the Crucible.
A medium XP lamp (Attack) is a fairly common prize from Treasure Hunter.
The monkey cape was an exclusive reward from the Wild Weekend beginning on 26 May 2012.
It was obtainable after finding all 10 monkeys in Chase the Monkey, after which the cape appeared in the player's inventory.
Moonstone Gala Attire is a cosmetic override set that can be obtained by redeeming all Gala Attire tokens.
These tokens can be won from Treasure Hunter during the Vault of Gemstones promotion.
It can be found inside the Araxyte Hive, stuck in a web near the entrance to the fight with Araxxor.
The outfit has also been available in the H'oddments Store.
It could only be obtained from the Squeal of Fortune or by sending 50 Valentine hearts and again from the balloon drops during Summer Escape in 2019.
